{{Quote|Your Royalness, what you don't know about me&mdash;or my 'style'&mdash;would fill the Imperial Library.|Han Solo to Leia Organa|<ref name="Star Wars Annual (1977) 1">[[Star Wars Annual (1977) 1|''Star Wars Annual'' (1977) 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Imperial Records Library''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computerized]] system holding the records of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The library would be moved when the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] relocated. It contained [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] personal files, including a list of [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guardsmen]]; it was through it that [[Vilim Disra]] discovered [[Grodin Tierce]]'s former status as one.

It existed as early as [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], at which point [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] installed a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Chiss homing beacon|homing beacon]] in it, to allow the [[Empire of the Hand]] to always know where the Imperial Remnant was.<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> By [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], the Library had been moved to the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]].
